Strait of Hormuz Traffic Declines Amid Iran-US Tensions

Traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has slowed following threats of retaliation from Iran against US attacks. Iran has also raised gasoline prices for heavy users. These developments occur amidst ongoing US sanctions impacting Iran's economy. International wire services reported these events on September 7, 2026.
